51' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic easily deals with the threat.

29' Good work from Espanyol as they win a corner.

23' Pere Milla (Espanyol) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

15' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.

10' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
8' Portu (Girona) sends an accurate pass to Vladyslav Vanat, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
6' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
